summary: British American Tobacco p.l.c. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release, the US equivalent of a current report on Form 8-K, disclosing routine PDMR share purchases under the EU/UK Market Abuse Regulation. Chief Corporate Officer Kingsley Wheaton bought 57 ordinary shares of 25p at 40.76 pence and his closely associated person Yulia Wheaton bought 345 shares at 40.92 pence, both on September 8, 2026, on the London Stock Exchange, totaling roughly 402 shares for about £16,441. No board recommendation, advisor, deal terms, or structural mechanics are involved.
